anchor.title: I Want YOU for U.S. Army (Uncle Sam)
anchor.creator: James Montgomery Flagg
anchor.caption: J.M. Flagg's 'I Want YOU' (1917). The poster turned civic and military service into a personal call — a reminder that citizenship carries responsibilities, not just rights.
anchor.alt: Cartoon: I Want YOU for U.S. Army (Uncle Sam) (James Montgomery Flagg, 1917).
